# Yahoo Tech

> > Yahoo Tech delivers technology news, product reviews, and buying guides covering AI, smartphones, gaming, streaming services, and consumer electronics.

Yahoo Tech provides comprehensive coverage of emerging technologies like ChatGPT, Apple Intelligence, and Microsoft Copilot, alongside practical reviews of phones, wearables, computing devices, and streaming platforms. The site also features daily puzzle hints and gaming news from major platforms including Xbox and Nintendo.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence (ChatGPT, Gemini, Apple Intelligence, Microsoft Copilot)
- Gaming (Xbox, Nintendo, PC Gaming)
- Streaming Services (Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Live TV)
- Smartphones and Mobile Devices
- Wearable Technology (Apple Watch, Fitness Trackers)
- Computing and Laptops
- Electric Vehicles and Transportation Tech
- Product Reviews and Buying Guides
- Daily Puzzles (Wordle, NYT Connections)
- Cybersecurity Software
- Camera and Photography Gear
- Audio Equipment (Headphones, Earbuds)
- Video Game Deals
- AI Assistants
- Consumer Electronics News

## Artificial Intelligence

- [AI News, Updates, Products and Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai): AI news covering Nvidia GTC, ChatGPT, Gemini, and machine learning tools
- [ChatGPT](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/chatgpt): ChatGPT news, features, and comparisons with Claude and Gemini
- [Apple Intelligence AI](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/apple-intelligence): Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features, updates, and guides
- [Microsoft Copilot AI](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/copilot): Microsoft Copilot AI news including Gaming Copilot and Excel features
- [Google Gemini AI](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/gemini): Google Gemini AI updates and Workspace integration news

## Mobile Devices and Wearables

- [Phone News, Updates, Products and Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/phones): iPhone 17e/16e news, mobile reviews, and smartphone accessories coverage
- [Wearable Technology News, Updates, Products and Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/wearables): Apple Watch, Amazfit, fitness trackers, and VR headset reviews and news

## Computing and Laptops

- [Computing and Laptop News, Updates, Products and Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/computing): Laptop, tablet, and computing news featuring Samsung Galaxy Book and Apple

## Streaming Services

- [Streaming News, Updates, Products and Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/streaming): Streaming services news, reviews, and live TV platform coverage
- [Streaming Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/streaming/reviews): Reviews of YouTube TV, ESPN+, Netflix, and other streaming services
- [Streaming Reviews and Guides](https://tech.yahoo.com/reviews-and-guides/streaming): Expert streaming guides for Disney+, Hulu, Netflix, and live TV services

## Gaming

- [Xbox](https://tech.yahoo.com/gaming/xbox): Xbox news covering Gaming Copilot, Project Helix, and Phil Spencer updates
- [Nintendo](https://tech.yahoo.com/gaming/nintendo): Nintendo and Switch 2 news, game announcements, and reviews
- [PC Gaming](https://tech.yahoo.com/gaming/pc): PC gaming news covering Xbox, Project Helix, and hardware updates

## Transportation Technology

- [Electric Vehicle News, Updates and Reviews](https://tech.yahoo.com/transportation/evs): EV news covering Honda, Rivian R2, robotaxis, and autonomous vehicles

## Daily Puzzles

- [Puzzle Hints](https://tech.yahoo.com/puzzles): Daily hints for Wordle, NYT Connections, Strands, and Quordle puzzles
- [Wordle Hints and Answers](https://tech.yahoo.com/puzzles/wordle): Daily Wordle hints, answers, and strategies from Yahoo Tech

## Optional

- [Camera Deals and Sales](https://tech.yahoo.com/cameras/deals): Camera and photography gear deals including DJI drones and accessories
- [Audio Deals and Sales](https://tech.yahoo.com/audio/deals): Headphones, earbuds, and soundbar deals from Sony, Baseus, and Soundcore
- [Cybersecurity Deals and Discounts](https://tech.yahoo.com/cybersecurity/deals): 1Password, Fortect, and cybersecurity software deals and discounts
